goal.raw_text: The player opens a previously saved game.

claims.content: The software application must be running.
A previously saved game file must exist and be accessible to the system.
The player selects the "Open game ..." option from the Game menu.

trigger.raw_text: The player selects the "Open game ..." option from the Game menu.

claims.content: The player selects "Open game ..." from the Game menu.
A dialog box opens, allowing the user to choose a file that contains all the data of a previously saved game.
The user selects a saved game file from the dialog box.
The board game is re-drawn according to the data from the selected file.
The player statistics are set to the values stored in the file data.
The game board is displayed with the block positions as they were when the game was saved.
The player's statistics (name, number of block movements, time passed) are loaded and reflect the state from the saved file.
The game is in a playable state, ready for the player to continue from the saved point.
